name: Flamecharm Obelisk
desc:
The Flamecharm Obelisk is an NPC located in a small hidden cave with lava flowing out at [Saramaed Summit](location:saramaed_summit)'s highest area. It must be located and interacted with, along with [4 other element-based obelisks](entity:saintsworn_obelisks), to obtain the Saintsworn Oath.

It can only be interacted with if you have at least 15 Flamecharm. When interacted with, Jace, the Hero of Flame, will speak to the player.
